description.en: A branching shrub has divaricate axes bearing leaves and immature reproductive structures.
description.zh: 分枝灌木具有叉开枝轴、叶片和未成熟生殖结构。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Wielandiella angustifolia; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Wielandiella angustifolia 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Open forked shrub architecture differs from the existing cycad's single short armored trunk.
distinctness.zh: 疏开叉枝灌木架构区别于现有苏铁单一短甲胄干。

modeling_brief.en: Give the branch forks priority over leaf density; use the revised organismal reconstruction rather than old flower drawings.
modeling_brief.zh: 突出叉枝而非叶片密度，采用修订整株重建而非旧花形绘图。

uncertainty: Some historical organ names are synonyms; reproductive maturity and sex interpretation are qualified.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: A revision of Wielandiella angustifolia
sources.supports: Branched bennettitalean shrub with associated leaves and immature cones.
